title_as_printed: Water activities and osmotic coefficients for the systems CaCl2(1) + NaCl(2) + H2O at 25 C
pressure_note: vapour pressure measured by the static method; vapour-phase non-ideality not corrected (stated in text); water activity = p/p0 of pure water at 25 C

value2.what: osmotic coefficient of the mixed solution, calculated by the authors from the measured water activity

conversion_needs: molality is not stated with 'mol/kg' in the table; the text calls m molalities (concentrated solutions up to I = 14); unit mol/kg assumed from usage 'molal' in text
notes: Measurements on both sides of the NaCl saturation limit (a_w = 0.75, I = 6). Printed '2:3501' in the m1 column (row 15) read as 2.3501 from the image.
